title: Juicy Smoky American Egg Noodles
description: A smoky and nostalgic American dish featuring egg noodles, char-grill flavor, and no onion or garlic, cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and brown sugar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a large ceramic tagine, combine the cooked egg noodles, the beef mixture, and the water.
Cover the tagine with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the noodles are heated through and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
